Exact_Proposed_Claim: In a systematic review of 16 controlled military studies, dietary-supplement findings were inconsistent and mostly modest, and the authors judged practical field-performance guidance inadequate.
Design: Systematic review of randomized and quasi-experimental controlled trials
Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.
Claim_Boundary: Does not justify a general supplementation protocol, causal field-readiness claim, or direct transfer to Brazilian public safety.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In 30 male firefighters receiving protein-carbohydrate regimens, adding creatine was associated with larger improvements in rescue and forcible-entry task times; several other tasks and total time showed no group-time interaction.
Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.
Claim_Boundary: Does not show that protein/carbohydrate alone caused benefit, that every occupational task improved, or that results generalize to female firefighters or Brazilian agencies.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: In 216 recruits followed for 12 months at one Chinese police academy, higher graduation-stage composite fitness was associated with higher supervisor-rated job performance and lower musculoskeletal-injury hazard; the cohort does not establish a causal effect of testing or conditioning.
Source_Locator: Results Table 1 and multivariable regression results; Limitations.
Population: 216 followed recruits at one Chinese police academy
Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.
Claim_Boundary: Does not prove that fitness testing, assignment, or conditioning causes lower injury or better performance.

Exact_Proposed_Claim: Among 34 Slovenian infantry personnel, end-running speed, maximal heart rate and predicted VO2max from the 30-15 intermittent fitness test showed test-retest ICCs of 0.971, 0.960 and 0.975, respectively; this does not validate a readiness score or operational prediction in other populations.
Transferability: International source; no automatic Brazil transfer.
Claim_Boundary: Does not validate the test for Brazilian policing, establish combat readiness, or prove outcome prediction beyond this small infantry cohort.
